sw21-s3.name: The underpinnings paragraph, step 3 from #324: HDAC inhibition said with the ketones
sw21-s3.text: Neurological De-Armoring is about fixing the underpinnings, not redecorating. It's a protocol that works like a metabolic solvent that softens the "concrete" in the brainstem by using Glutamate modulation and supplementing Ketones (BHB, which block HDACs) so we can dig under the house and pour a new foundation, and eventually work on the psychology upstairs.
